description: Three measurements of semantic preservation across the bounded Z3 / unbounded Tamarin transition: that both backends are driven by the same property AST, how much of the vocabulary the declared MSR skeleton can witness at all, and how often the two backends agree on properties it can witness -- with disagreements classified rather than discarded.

encoding_equivalence.detail: no countermodel: the two encodings are the same bounded sentence
encoding_equivalence.legacy_goal:
ForAll([s, ue, sn, k],
       Implies(And(ru1_authenticated_with(s, ue, sn),
                   ru1_accepts(s, ue)),
               ru1_key_bound_to(s, k, sn)))
encoding_equivalence.ast_derived_goal:
ForAll([s, u, n, key],
       Implies(And(ru1_accepts(s, u),
                   ru1_authenticated_with(s, u, n)),
               ru1_key_bound_to(s, key, n)))

encoding_equivalence.detail: no countermodel: the two encodings are the same bounded sentence
encoding_equivalence.legacy_goal:
ForAll([m, ue, hn],
       Implies(ru2_identifies(m, ue),
               ru2_encrypted_with_hn_key(m, hn)))
encoding_equivalence.ast_derived_goal:
ForAll([m, u, h],
       Implies(ru2_identifies(m, u),
               ru2_encrypted_with_hn_key(m, h)))

encoding_equivalence.detail: no countermodel: the two encodings are the same bounded sentence
encoding_equivalence.legacy_goal:
ForAll([s, ue],
       Implies(ru3_accepts(s, ue),
               ru3_res_matches_xres(s, ue)))
encoding_equivalence.ast_derived_goal:
ForAll([s, u],
       Implies(ru3_accepts(s, u),
               ru3_res_matches_xres(s, u)))

schema_expressiveness.note: The unbounded leg can only witness properties over the action facts the declared skeleton emits. Everything outside that set is an expert modelling task, not an automated one.

bounded_theory.note: The extracted specification itself, as the bounded model under test.

expert_guard_required.meaning: bounded-verified but unbounded-falsified: the extracted rule entails the property, yet the operational model admits a trace violating it. Closing these needs an operational guard the bounded leg cannot see.

guard_localisation.rule: IF authenticated_with(s:Session, u:UE, n:SN) THEN key_bound_to(s:Session, key:Key, n:SN)
IF authenticated_with(session:Session, ue:UE, sn:SN) THEN key_bound_to(session:Session, k:Key, sn:SN)
IF authenticated_with(session:Session, ue:UE, sn:SN) THEN accepts(session:Session, ue:UE)
IF authenticated_with(session:Session, ue:UE, sn:SN) THEN key_bound_to(session:Session, k:Key, sn:SN)
